senses.zh_definition: 瓦莱丽；源自欧洲语言的人名，通常用作女性名字。在马来语句子中属于专有名词。
senses.en_definition: A personal name, usually feminine, used as a proper noun in Malay discourse.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas orang yang lazimnya digunakan sebagai nama perempuan.
senses.nuances: 规范书写为 Valerie，首字母大写。它指称个人，不等于马来语中表示“坚强”的普通词。输入未提供上下文，不能确定所指人物；这里的 official 状态不表示已获 DBP 人名审定。名字形式及常见读音参见 [Behind the Name：Valerie](https://www.behindthename.com/name/valerie)。

etymology.historical_story: Valerie belongs to a European naming tradition connected with Latin Valeria, the feminine form of the Roman family name Valerius. Its deeper association is with Latin valere, meaning to be strong or well. French Valérie helped transmit the name into English. In Malay conversation, the name identifies its bearer; its historical association with strength is not its everyday lexical meaning. [Source: Etymonline](https://www.etymonline.com/word/Valerie).
